why: A July 2025 arXiv preprint (2507.22284) proves 'Kalai's flag conjecture' for locally anti-blocking polytopes, extending an August 2023 (pre-snapshot) result proving the 3^d conjecture itself for that class; unclear whether this newer paper's flag-conjecture result for a restricted polytope class counts as settling a genuine case of the stated 3^d conjecture or is a related-but-different (stronger, flag-vector) conjecture, and the general conjecture remains open in higher dimensions.
